checked.correction: Row count and ODbL share-alike claim are correct, but the researcher omitted a disqualifying fact: overpass-api.de's own robots.txt Disallows /api/ — the exact path proposed. The repo's non-negotiable constraint is 'respect robots.txt', and polite_get() honouring robots.txt would refuse this endpoint. Separately, OSMF API policy (operations.osmfoundation.org/policies/api) states the API is 'not for read-only purposes or projects' and 'Large or frequent data users must use the download service planet.osm'. Bulk route-relation ingestion must come from Geofabrik/planet extracts, not Overpass. Overpass is defensible only for occasional small spot-checks.

verdict_summary:
All 12 claimed URLs are live (HTTP 200). Numeric accuracy is unusually good: NN 478,999 / NN=1 453,529 / NN>0 454,830 / NN=0 24,169 / distinct ROUTEID 12,491 / distinct ID 478,999 / Delaware 472; NHFN 12,989; NHS 492,005; FAF5 487,394 with Truck NOT NULL 4,365 = 3,519 Prohibited + 718 Restrictions + 128 Reserved; STRAHNET 97,118; NHPN 626,366; catalog 1,023 services; HPMS 6,039,201 with NHS>0 409,627, NHFN>0 89,444, AADT_COMBINATION>0 1,125,655; Overpass US:I 975 relations; LNAME blank 411,754; SIGN1 variants ' I1'/'I1'/'IA1'; ID 444801/444802 genuinely duplicate on the proposed composite key. Every one of those reproduced on the wire. License text was read directly from copyrightText, not assumed, and the 17 U.S.C. §101 / metadata-must-travel distinction between NN-FAF5 and NHFN-NHS-STRAHNET is real.

Three material defects. First, REFUTED: "no national interchange or highway-junction point layer exists" is false — NTAD_Freight_Analysis_Framework_Network_Nodes sits in the same catalog, is public domain, and carries Interchange, Exit_Number, Entry_or_Exit with real named values (4,485 / 3,102 / 4,472 populated of 974,788). Sparse, so computed junctions still needed, but those rows are free authoritative ground truth and should be ingested before reaching for ODbL OSM. Second, Overpass: overpass-api.de/robots.txt reads "Disallow: /api/" — the exact path proposed — which collides with the repo's non-negotiable robots.txt rule; OSMF policy also pushes bulk users to planet/Geofabrik extracts. Use extracts, not Overpass, for ingestion. Third, NN vintage: every row is VERSION 2020.01.10, YEAR 2018, so observed_at = 2020-12-22 is not supported by row attributes — the data is older than advertised.

Minor: LNAME non-blank is 43,076 not 43,074; HPMS layer 0 is misnamed "Culverts"; unprefixed National_Network mirror has empty copyrightText; the no-state-mosaic conclusion generalizes from one state probed.
